title: NTDSutil creates Active Directory installation media
description: Detects ntdsutil.exe commands that activate the NTDS instance and create installation media through IFM.

hypothesis.summary: An adversary may use NTDSutil IFM to create a copy of the Active Directory database for offline credential extraction.
hypothesis.rationale: MITRE records ntdsutil.exe as a method for copying NTDS.dit, Microsoft documents IFM as an elevated installation-media function and SigmaHQ detects the same command family; legitimate domain-controller provisioning remains possible.
hypothesis.detection_goal: Identify ntdsutil.exe commands that activate NTDS and create full, RODC or SYSVOL installation media through IFM while leaving unrelated maintenance and incomplete fragments unmatched.

data_sources.name: Microsoft Defender for Endpoint process events

triage.summary: Treat the event as domain-controller-sensitive, identify the output path and verify that an approved IFM operation explains it.
steps: Review the command line, device role, account, initiating process and installation-media destination.
Confirm a documented domain-controller deployment or recovery change with the responsible directory-services owner.
Inspect access to the output, subsequent archive or transfer activity and related credential access; contain the host and rotate exposed credentials when unauthorized.
false_positives: Approved Active Directory domain-controller installation, recovery or backup preparation using IFM

validation.expected_outcome: Match ntdsutil IFM creation for full, RODC or SYSVOL media after activating NTDS; do not match unrelated maintenance, incomplete fragments, other binaries or absent evidence.
